look.why: A soft cherry-blossom rose pink that echoes Japanese spring blossoms and complements the expressive red face.

size.measure: head to rump about 0.5–0.65 m plus short 8–10 cm tail (body 47–60 cm per ADW)

habitat.text: Subtropical evergreen forests, cool temperate broadleaf woods and snowy subalpine mountains across Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu.

diet.text: Fruits, seeds, young leaves, buds, tree bark, fungi, insects and crabs.

facts.text: Known as 'snow monkeys', they are the northernmost-living non-human primates and famously soak in volcanic hot springs.
Troops pass down learned cultural behaviors, such as washing sweet potatoes in seawater before eating them.

id.habitat: Hutan subtropis hijau abadi, hutan beriklim sedang, dan pegunungan bersalju di Honshu, Shikoku, dan Kyushu.
id.diet: Buah-buahan, biji-bijian, daun muda, kuncup, kulit kayu, jamur, serangga, dan kepiting.
facts: Dijuluki 'monyet salju', mereka adalah primata non-manusia yang hidup paling utara dan terkenal berendam di pemandian air panas.
Kawanan mewariskan perilaku budaya seperti mencuci ubi jalar di air laut sebelum memakannya.
